'''Roger Guilard''' is a French [[chemist]]. He is a professor of chemistry at the [[University of Burgundy]] in [[Dijon]], France<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.icmub.com/fr/membres/guilard-roger.html|title=GUILARD Roger - ICMUB Institut de Chimie Moléculaire de l'Université de Bourgogne|website=www.icmub.com}}</ref><ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=http://www.icmub.com/images/stories/member/guilard_roger/guilard_roger_bio.pdf|title=Bio Express - Roger Guilard|last=Guilard|first=Roger|date=2019-04-18}}</ref> where he is a member of the Institute of Molecular Chemistry of the University of Burgundy.<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.icmub.com/en/members-en/guilard-roger.html|title=GUILARD Roger - ICMUB Institut de Chimie Moléculaire de l'Université de Bourgogne|website=www.icmub.com|language=en-gb|access-date=2019-04-24}}</ref>

== Career ==

Guilard received the "Agrégation de Sciences Physiques" Degree in 1966 and a PhD in 1971 from the [[University of Burgundy]].<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.usherbrooke.ca/a-propos/histoire-de-luniversite/docteurs-dhonneur/docteurs/g/roger-guilard/|title=Roger Guilard - À propos - Université de Sherbrooke|website=www.usherbrooke.ca|access-date=2019-04-17}}</ref>  He was a Postdoctoral Fellow at the [[University of Basel]], Switzerland and at the University of Darmstadt, Germany from 1972 to 1973,<ref name=":3" /> and subsequently has been at the University of Burgundy from 1973 to present.<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":2" /> At the University of Burgundy he has been the director of the Laboratory of Synthesis and Organometallic Electrosynthesis<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":2" /> and the Molecular Engineering Laboratory for Separation and Applications of Gases.<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":1" />

Guilard was Scientific Director of the Department of Chemistry at the French Ministry of Education, Technology and Research,<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":2" /> and then Managing Director for the partnership of local authorities in the Partnership Branch of the [[Centre national de la recherche scientifique|Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique]], CNRS.<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":2" />

Guilard founded two companies, Chematech<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.chematech-mdt.com/history/|title=History – www.chematech-mdt.com|language=en-US|access-date=2019-04-15}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://carnot.org/mentors/les-mentors-sciences?lang=en|title=Sciences Mentors|website=Fondation Carnot|language=en-US|access-date=2019-04-15}}</ref> and PorphyChem<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.porphychem.com/en/about-us/history/1|title=PorphyChem - Porphyrin Chemicals & Engineering|website=www.porphychem.com|access-date=2019-04-15}}</ref>  which produce tetraazamacrocycles, [[porphyrin]]s, [[phthalocyanine]]s and related compounds, respectively, for use in research, industrial applications<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.porphychem.com/en/about-us/porphychem-company/2|title=PorphyChem - Porphyrin Chemicals & Engineering|website=www.porphychem.com|access-date=2019-04-15}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.chematech-mdt.com/mission/|title=Mission – www.chematech-mdt.com|language=en-US|access-date=2019-04-15}}</ref> and health care.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.porphychem.com/en/expertise/health/26|title=PorphyChem - Porphyrin Chemicals & Engineering|website=www.porphychem.com|access-date=2019-04-15}}</ref>  He is also a member of the advisory board of LARS - Ligament Augmentation and Reconstruction System<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":0" /> which provides synthetic ligaments for soft tissue repair.

Guilard holds 23 patents, including a technique for decontamination of radioactive elements from wastewater,<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{cite patent|country=FR|number=FR2802928 (A1)|title=Compounds derived from polyazacycloalkane derivatives with at least four cyclic nitrogen atoms used for removing heavy metals from water or hydrogen peroxide|status=|pubdate=June 29, 2001|fdate=|pridate=|gdate=|inventor=|invent1=|invent2=|assign1=|assign2=|url=https://worldwide.espacenet.com/publicationDetails/biblio?II=18&ND=3&adjacent=true&locale=en_EP&FT=D&date=20010629&CC=FR&NR=2802928A1&KC=A1#|class=}}</ref> a process for removing lead from drinking water<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{cite patent|country=WO|number=WO/2001/046202|title=(En) Polyazacycloalkanes, Organometallic Complexes That Incorporate Them as Ligands and the Use of Said Compounds in the Extraction of Heavy Metals; (Fr) Polyazacycloalcanes, Complexes Organometalliques les Incorporant Comme Ligands Ainsi Que Utilisation Desdits Composes A L'extraction de Metaux Lourds|status=|pubdate=July 28, 2001|fdate=|pridate=|gdate=|inventor=|invent1=|invent2=|inventor1-first=|assign1=|assign2=|url=https://patentscope.wipo.int/search/en/detail.jsf?docId=WO2001046202&recNum=4&office=&queryString=FP%3A%28roger+guilard%29+46202&prevFilter=&sortOption=Pub+Date+Desc&maxRec=4|class=}}</ref><ref>{{cite patent|country=WO|number=WO/2009/112736|title=(En) Materials For The Solid/Liquid Extraction Of Heavy Metal Ions, Containing Supported N-Functionalised Polyazacycloalkanes (Fr) Matériaux Pour L'extraction Solide/Liquide De Cations De Métaux Lourds À Base De Polyazacycloalcanes N-Fonctionnalisés Supportés|status=|pubdate=|fdate=|pridate=|gdate=|inventor=|invent1=|invent2=|inventor1-first=|assign1=|assign2=|url=https://patentscope.wipo.int/search/en/detail.jsf?docId=WO2009112736&redirectedID=true|class=}}</ref> and a carbon monoxide sensor.<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{cite patent|country=WO|number=WO/2003/011865|title=(En) Novel Materials For Selective Trapping Of Carbon Monoxide; (Fr) Nouveaux Materiaux Pour Le Piegeage Selectif Du Monoxyde De|status=|pubdate=13 February 2003|fdate=|pridate=|gdate=|inventor=|invent1=|invent2=|inventor1-first=|assign1=|assign2=|url=https://patentscope.wipo.int/search/en/detail.jsf?docId=WO2003011865&redirectedID=true|class=}}</ref> He has published more than 475 articles in peer-reviewed journals<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=HUoVyCYAAAAJ&hl=en|title=Roger Guilard - Google Scholar Citations|website=scholar.google.com|access-date=2019-04-18}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Roger_Guilard|title=Roger Guilard {{!}} Doctor {{!}} University of Burgundy, Dijon {{!}} UB {{!}} Institut de Chimie Moléculaire de l'Université de Bourgogne (ICMUB)|last=Doctor|first=Roger GuilardUniversity of Burgundy {{!}} UB · Institut de Chimie Moléculaire de l'Université de Bourgogne48 80 ·|website=ResearchGate|language=en|access-date=2019-04-18}}</ref> and has co-edited several influential book series including The Porphyrin Handbook,<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://kadish.chem.uh.edu/porhb.html|title=Karl M. Kadish|website=kadish.chem.uh.edu|access-date=2019-04-17}}</ref> the [[Handbook of Porphyrin Science]],<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldscientific.com/series/porsci|title=Handbook of Porphyrin Science|website=www.worldscientific.com|language=en|access-date=2019-04-17}}</ref>  the World Scientific Series on Chemistry, Energy and the Environment,<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldscientific.com/series/scee|title=Series on Chemistry, Energy and the Environment|website=www.worldscientific.com|language=en|access-date=2019-04-17}}</ref> and the World Scientific Series: From Biomaterials Towards Medical Devices.<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldscientific.com/series/fbmd|title=World Scientific Series: From Biomaterials Towards Medical Devices|website=www.worldscientific.com|language=en|access-date=2019-04-17}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://data.bnf.fr/fr/12834861/roger_guilard/|title=Roger Guilard|website=data.bnf.fr|access-date=2019-04-17}}</ref> He was an associate editor for the journal ''[[Dalton Transactions]]''<ref name=":3" /> and has served on the editorial boards for ''Dalton Transactions,''<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":7">{{Cite journal|last1=Walton|first1=Paul|last2=Humphrey|first2=Jamie|date=2006-12-14|title=Dalton Transactions: Developing for the Inorganic Community|journal=Dalton Transactions|language=en|issue=1|pages=15–17|doi=10.1039/B516708F|issn=1477-9234}}</ref> the ''[[Journal of Porphyrins and Phthalocyanines]]''<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":5">{{Cite web|url=http://www.icpp-spp.org/icpp1/htmlgb/menu.html|title=ICPP-Menu|website=www.icpp-spp.org|access-date=2019-04-24}}</ref><ref name=":6">{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldscientific.com/sda/1063/sample-v13n01.pdf|title=JPP 2009 front matter listing Roger Guilard as Editorial Board member|access-date=April 24, 2019}}</ref> and the ''[[New Journal of Chemistry]].''<ref name=":3" />

== Selected awards/honors ==

* 2013 - "Grand Prix - Emile Jungfleish" Grand prize from the [[French Academy of Sciences]],<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/archivage_site/activite/prix/plaquette_2013.pdf|title=Cérémonies sous la Coupole de l'Institut de France le 15 octobre et le 26 novembre 2013 La grande médaille et les grands prix de l'Académie des sciences 2013}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bienpublic.com/actualite/2013/10/15/le|title=Le prix Jungfleisch remis au professeur Guilard|website=www.bienpublic.com|date=October 15, 2013 |language=FR-fr|access-date=2019-04-12}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/archivage_site/activite/prix/s2013a/s2013.htm|title=Séance du 15 octobre 2013 - Première séance solennelle de remise des Prix de l'Académie des sciences|website=www.academie-sciences.fr|access-date=2019-04-12}}</ref>
* 2010 - [[Robert Burns Woodward]] Career Award in Porphyrin Chemistry, 6th International Conference on Porphyrins and Phthalocyanines (ICPP)<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.icpp-spp.org/icpp6/general/awards.php|title=Society of Porphyrins & Phthalocyanines|website=www.icpp-spp.org}}</ref>
* 2001 - "Grand Prix - Gaz de France (Applications)" Grand prize from the [[French Academy of Sciences]]<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":1" />
* 2001 - Honoris Causa Doctorate from the [[Université de Sherbrooke|University of Sherbrooke]] (Canada)<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":2" />
* 1997 - "Prix - Paul Langevin" Prize from the [[French Academy of Sciences]]<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Guilard_Roger|title=Academy of Europe: Guilard Roger|website=www.ae-info.org|access-date=2019-04-17}}</ref>
* 1999 - [[Association of American Publishers]] Award for Excellence in Professional/Scholarly Publishing<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{cite web|url=https://proseawards.com/winners/1999-award-winners/|title=1999 Award Winners|website=PROSE Awards}}</ref>
* 1991 - "Prix - Marguerite de la Charlonie" Prize from the [[French Academy of Sciences]]<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":1" />
* 1978 - "Prix -  Société chimique de France" Prize from the [[Société chimique de France|French Chemical Society (SCF)]], Coordination Chemistry Division<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.lactualitechimique.org/Informations-SCF-4353|title=Informations SCF - L'Actualité Chimique|website=www.lactualitechimique.org|access-date=2019-04-17}}</ref>

== Memberships/fellowships/positions ==

* 2000–present - Vice President of the Society of Porphyrins and Phthalocyanines (SPP)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.spp-jpp.org/committee/|title=Committee|website=SPP {{!}} Society of Porphyrins and Phthalocyanines|language=en-GB|access-date=2019-04-18}}</ref>
* 1996-2018 - Editorial board of Journal of Porphyrins and Phthalocyanines (JPP)<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":5" /><ref name=":6" />
* 2015 - Fellow of the [[Academia Europaea]]<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":1" />
* 2014 - Distinguished Member of the [[Société chimique de France|French Chemical Society]]<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.societechimiquedefrance.fr/Membres-distingues-31.html?lang=fr|title=Société Chimique de France|website=www.societechimiquedefrance.fr|access-date=2019-04-17}}</ref>
* 2008 - [[Japan Society for the Promotion of Science]] (JSPS) fellow<ref name=":3" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.jsps.go.jp/english/e-plaza/alumni/france/data/FY2006.pdf|title=Presentation of Japan Society for the Promotion of Science, 2006|website=Japan Society for the Promotion of Science|access-date=2019-04-18}}</ref>
* 1997-2002 - Member, Editorial Board of the New Journal of Chemistry<ref name=":3" />
* 1996-2002 - Associate Editor and member, Editorial Board of the Journal of the Royal Chemical Society, Dalton Transactions<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":7" />
* 2001 - [[National Order of Merit (France)|Knight of the National Order of Merit]], France<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.france-phaleristique.com/onm_promo_14-05-01.htm|title=Ordre national du Mérite - Nominations, promotions et élévations du 14-05-2001|website=www.france-phaleristique.com|access-date=2019-04-12}}</ref>
* 1999 - Commander, [[Ordre des Palmes Académiques|Order of Academic Palms]]<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":1" />
